notes.title: Closing sever Notice
notes.content: Dear Players: Thank you for participating in the opening test of NineTrails. In order to apply for the license of China, we need to close the sever to meet the requirement of government. It will last 3 months, so that we can improve the content, version and service of the game, and focus on the development of new models. In the open test, all player data will be retained. Here we thank you for your support and love for the NineTrails! We will inform you of the next test time. Please pay attention to the official website and the announcement in the official group. We sincerely thank you for your understanding of our work. At the same time, please look forward to new content of NineTrials again!

notes.title: The game is free of charge
notes.content:
Dear player. 
It has been 205 days since the launch of "Nine hijacked songs: cursed Land" on June 28, 1919, and the game studio thanks every player who has walked with us for more than half a year. When it was launched in June, the studio had to go online in a hurry due to lack of funds. fortunately, there were free publicity by anchors on various major platforms, and you supported the full support of domestic game players, so the studio was able to continue to operate. I would like to express my heartfelt thanks here. However, due to the imperfection of the game at that time and the lack of budget for follow-up publicity, it was difficult for us to maintain a high number of daily active users to ensure the normal experience of players, so we decided to open the game for free on January 21, 2020, so that more players can participate in order to ensure the game experience of every player. Prior to the purchase of the game body players, we also prepared 600 Lingshi + out-of-print set / platinum Sheng Xianling as compensation. We guarantee that every penny of the revenue from the game will be invested in follow-up research and development, and thanks again to the players who have supported us. 
-- NINE TRIALS operation team

notes.title: Update announcement
notes.content:

Official maintenance will be carried out at 0: 00 a.m. on January 21, 20, with an estimated maintenance time of 6 hours. if the maintenance is completed ahead of time, the server will be turned on ahead of time. Please tell each other that you should pay attention to the game time in advance and be ready to go offline. If the maintenance content cannot be completed within the scheduled time, the boot time will be postponed. Please refer to the official announcement for details. 
After this update, the game will be permanently free. Players who have purchased the game body before January 21 will receive a compensation reward of 600 Lingshi + Platinum Shengxian Ling or out-of-print fashion to choose one of the two (log in to the game to get it after the update). New model: Night falls
Brush ring mechanism adjustment: the brush ring will be divided into four stages: the first lap will have a waiting time of 300 seconds (day), and the first lap will have a closing time of 210 seconds (day). The waiting time for the second lap is 240 seconds (night), and the closing time is 180 seconds (day). The waiting time of the third lap is 210 seconds (dark night), and the shrinking time is 160 seconds(day). The waiting time of the fourth lap is 120 seconds (night), and the shrinking time is 35 seconds (day).
With the progress of the game, the game will have day and night alternating, during the dark night will refresh the ghost monster around the player, the player needs to run to "drive soul array" in order to ensure that the ghost is not disturbed. Ghosts can be attacked and killed, but as long as the player's location is not covered by the "exorcism circle", the ghost will be refreshed regularly around the player until the character dies or day comes.

notes.title: 月底大版本更新预告，黑夜即将降临
notes.content:
仙侠动作竞技端游《九劫曲》将于月底迎来“黑夜降临”大版本更新，本次除了新模式上线外，另有新武器新场景新皮肤等新内容上线，具体详见以下更新内容。
随着诅咒之地死者越来越多，那些长眠于此地的化成怨魂厉鬼倾巢而出，寻找活着的生灵来发泄心中怨恨。而那些原本居住此地的人们曾经在修仙者的帮助下修建了一个个阵眼祭坛，每当黑夜来临，祭坛内的灵石就会驱动阵法来保护法阵内的人们。

新玩法
      新增黑夜降临玩法，游戏开始后，在第一次缩圈完毕，第二次缩圈倒计时期间开始第一次进入黑夜，此后所有缩圈等待时间倒计时都会进入黑夜，直到缩圈开始。黑夜时间会在玩家身边刷新鬼魂，玩家需去“法阵”内以保证不被鬼魂打死。黑夜期间“法阵”点会在大地图标记显示，并且光照会区别于非“法阵”点区域，鬼魂进入“法阵”照亮区域会销毁死亡，玩家们可在白天尽可能多的搜寻物资，以备黑夜时应对各种突发战斗。
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34250617/f06d083991087e38d817a15ac77ad31da7d06e9b.jpg[/img]
新武器
      风暴的化身—新武器乾坤扇，为风系远程武器，驱动各种风系能量战斗，擅长空连。
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34250617/6cb7b342cf2195dadb9a153e490c5b35f19b8f1e.png[/img]
新场景
      大逃杀地图新增“寅家村”场景，玩家后续可选择此资源点出生，资源点里有四级长枪“八宝亮银枪”。
      寅家村先祖曾是威正八方的伏魔将领，其后人世代居住于此，羽化后留下神兵“八宝亮银枪”，以待后人持此神兵守护这一方土地。
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34250617/e66126d0b1cf01beaafa4eea812c86156240b869.jpg[/img]

新机制
      本次更新上线秘宝机制，秘宝刷新掉落时会在地图上标记，并且掉落处周围会形成陨石雨，被陨石雨砸中的玩家会扣除血量。在一定范围内，玩家可以看到陨石雨下落，并选择是否赶往秘宝区，下落过程中宝箱会直接坠落，宝箱内有丰富物资。

新皮肤
      商店新增印记时装—猫妖，相传用暗影猫妖皮毛所制，穿上之人可夜视千里，灵探八方。
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34250617/7256874758b4a1af621e5667948e30c556f8494e.jpg[/img]
除了以上新内容外，训练场将会加入概念武器：弓，具体更新时间，敬请留意官网资讯！

Fairy warrior action competitive PC game "Nine Trials" will be ushered in at the end of the month, "the arrival of the night" version of the update, in addition to the new mode online, there are new weapons, new scenes, new skin and other new content online, details see the following update content. 
As more and more dead  died in the cursed land, those who lay here turned into grievances and poured out in search of living creatures to vent their resentment in their hearts. Those who had lived here had built altars with the help of fairy practitioners, and whenever the night came, spiritual stone in the altar would drive the magic to protect the people in the dharma.
New plays method. 
New night falls to play, after the start of the game, after the first circle, the second circle countdown began for the first time into the night, and then all the circle waiting time countdown will enter the night.
The night time will refresh the ghost next to the player, the player needs to go to the "Magic circle" to ensure that he will not be killed by the ghost. 
During the night, the "Magic circle" point will be displayed on the big map mark, and the light note is different from the non-"normal" point area. Ghosts entering the "Magic circle" illuminated area will destroy death, and players can search for as many supplies as possible during the day. 
In case of sudden fighting in the dark.
New weapons. 
The embodiment of the storm-the new weapon Qiankun Fan, for the wind system long-range weapons, drive a variety of wind system energy combat, good at air company.
New scene. 
Escape mode map added "Yinjia Village" scene, players can choose this resource point to be born, there are four levels of long gun "eight treasures bright silver gun." 
Ancestors of Yinjia Village used to be the voodoo generals, and their descendants lived here for generations to live here. After Eclosion, they left behind "eight treasures bright silver guns" to wait for future generations to guard this side of the land.
New mechanism. 
This time update the online secret treasure mechanism, the secret treasure refresh drop will be marked on the map, and will form a meteorite rain around the fall, the player hit by meteorite rain will deduct blood. Within a certain range, players can see the meteorite rainfall, and choose whether to rush to the secret treasure area, the treasure box will fall directly in the process of falling, there are rich materials in the treasure box. 
New skin. 
Store new imprint fashion clothes-cat demon, rumored to be made of shadow cat demon fur, the wearing people can see thousands of miles. Spirit can feel everywhere.

In addition to the above new content, the training ground will add concept weapons: bow, specific update time, please pay attention to the official website information!

notes.title: About the game
notes.content:
大家好！我们是国内独立开发小团队，这款游戏经过两年的时间，现在是时候呈现给各位了！目前游戏版本是抢先体验版，可能还会存在BUG等问题，希望大家能够理解，我们会尽快努力修复。各位在游戏体验中遇到的BUG或者有更好的想法可以加群讨论（QQ：792689320）或直接留言提出，我们会及时查看！对于游戏中的问题，还请各位能给我们一些时间，我们将不断的优化游戏，让这款游戏变的更好！谢谢大家的理解与支持。

Hello everyone! We are a small independent development team in China. After two years, it's time to present this game to you. At present, the game version is an Early Access version, there may be BUG and other issues, I hope you can understand, we will try our best to repair all kinds of BUG. The BUG you encountered in the game experience or have better ideas can be discussed in Steam community, we will check in time! For BUG problem we will repair in time, please give us time to deal with, we will continue to optimize the game, make this game better! Thanks!
